about: The same join for every author (editor spec §30, same_join_every_author). Each case is a base, two edits of it (ours and theirs) and a merge of their text. The edits are joined over the base by the §21 join, and the merged text is read against it: afterTextMerge (packages/graph-spec/src/mesh/after-text-merge.js) and after_text_merge (python/graph_spec/src/graphspec/engine/mesh/after_text_merge.py) must give each answer. A document is its lines; its header line is added, ours and theirs and the merge as revisions of the base. The tests also run each case with ours made on a desktop, a phone and by an AI, and the answers must match apart from who made the edit.

cases.name: a text merge that picks one of two values is followed by the join, which keeps the dispute for a person
edits that do not disagree leave the merge nothing to decide
a merge that keeps neither value still leaves the dispute, with nothing picked
